doc_title_en: Notice on Revision to Earnings Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
doc_title_jp: 業績予想および配当予想の修正（増配）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 生成AI関連製品の需要拡大を背景にメモリ価格上昇が当初想定を上回る

summary_en: ¥1,640/share (¥1,040 increase from ¥600 prior guidance) for FY3/27; 37.2% payout ratio. Revision driven by Q1 earnings beat on strong AI-related product demand and memory price strength. Company targets ¥300/share minimum dividend and 40% payout ratio by FY3/29 under mid-term plan.
summary_jp: FY3/27配当を1,640円/株に修正（従来予想600円から1,040円増）、配当性向37.2%。生成AI関連製品需要拡大とメモリ価格上昇を背景にQ1決算が想定超過。中期計画期間（FY3/27-29）で配当下限300円、最終年度に配当性向40%を目指す。
tag_en: Dividend hike - ¥1,640/share (¥1,040 increase) - FY3/27 - 37.2% payout ratio
